prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, two women in a single row.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side in a daytime intercity train carriage with blue upholstered seats in rows along both sides of the aisle, luggage racks overhead, large windows showing blurred countryside, bright ceiling lights, a clean linoleum floor. Behind them, several ordinary passengers sitting in the seats and walking along the aisle are softly out of focus, their figures and faces blurred by shallow depth of field into gentle shapes and colours, while the women stay razor sharp in the foreground, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 2 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, bright daylight from the windows raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a calm, composed expression, soft rose-gold hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes. Long round nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Portuguese azulejo tile — a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's condition: A light smudge of soot marks her cheek and jawline, and a little soot dusts her fingertips, the backs of her hands and her bare feet.

Left woman's restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the floor beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips.

Left woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other woman, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the floor, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Left woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the floor, with a little soot on the soles and toes.

Right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, with the sweet look of a Japanese idol, soft full cheeks with a gently tapering jaw and a small chin, very large round dark eyes with a wide gaze, softly rounded brows, a small nose and small full lips, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, a calm, distant gaze, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman. Colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame. Not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer — glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease, dense scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's condition: A faint streak of soot crosses her cheekbone, and a little grime darkens her fingertips and the soles of her bare feet.

Right woman's restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the floor beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips.

Right woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other woman, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the floor, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Right woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the floor, with a little soot on the soles and toes.

Composition: the whole row of women fills the width of the tall frame, each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the light carving every fold and curve on all 2, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 vertical portrait 8K, taller than it is wide.
